messages:
emily: Quick design check: proposing a compact 'diff' chip in run history that flags when an action's output schema differs. Chip expands inline to show a short table of changed fields + a 'Show JSON' toggle. Need accessibility & copy feedback.

raj: Sounds good. Make chip compact for dense timelines. Replay should be available but not loud 1 maybe icon-only with tooltip.

nicole: Accessibility: icon-only controls need aria-labels. Chip must include text like 'Schema changed' and a count. On expand, focus should move to the diff and we should announce via aria-live.

joel: Engineering notes: replay will re-run with recorded inputs; warn if original run used a fallback model. Confirmation modal should include model info and a short excerpt of the request.

emily: Copy options for chip: 'Schema changed', 'Output mismatch', 'Field changes'. Which is clearest?

aria: 'Schema changed' is plain. For screen reader announce: 'Schema changed, 3 fields differ. Press Enter to expand.' Include the count in the chip.

raj: Concern: many chips might clutter. Add header-level filter 'Show only runs with schema changes' and a per-user default (opt-in).

nicole: For expand UI, compact table: field | expected | actual | sample. Show sample lazily. 'Show JSON' reveals full snippet.

joel: Perf note: avoid loading samples for many rows; lazy-load on expand and show skeleton. Also protect replay with Shift+R shortcut + confirmation.

emily: Accessibility checklist for mock: aria-labels, aria-live announcements, focus move into diff, role=dialog for replay modal, aria-modal=true, tooltip via aria-describedby.

aria: I'll add those attributes and run a quick VoiceOver/NVDA pass.

nicole: I'll draft microcopy for chip, tooltip, and modal (title: 'Replay action invocation', body: 'This will replay the recorded request with current routing. Proceed?'). Buttons: 'Cancel' / 'Replay'.

ux-bot: Mock uploaded: https://figma.redwood.com/file/xyz/run-history-diff-chip (comment '@emily annotate keyboard shortcuts').

emily: Thanks all, will update Figma and ping when done. :thumbsup:
